items.event_time_ist: 8:30 AM IST, Oct 14 (NHC Advisory 27, 8:00 PM MST Tue Oct 13)
items.title: Hurricane Simon re-strengthens to 110 mph, almost a major hurricane again
items.summary: NHC Advisory 27 (8 PM MST Tue Oct 13): Simon strengthened from 90 mph to 110 mph (95 kt), pressure 965 mb, centered ~125 mi W of Cabo Corrientes and ~125 mi SW of Las Islas Marias, drifting W at 2 mph. A 6:50 PM MST special tropical cyclone update says satellite/radar from Cabo San Lucas show 'significant' strengthening to near 110 mph. NHC forecast: 120 mph by Wednesday morning (could become a major hurricane again tonight), then gradual weakening from shear/dry air; storm remains tiny (hurricane-force winds extend only ~10 mi from center). Watches: no changes — Hurricane Watch for Las Islas Marias only; hurricane conditions possible there Thursday.

items.event_time_ist: 8:30 AM IST, Oct 14 (NHC Advisory 3, 9:00 PM CST Tue Oct 13)
items.title: Trudy strengthens to 45 mph; NHC nudges track east — major-hurricane threat to western Mexico this weekend
items.summary: NHC Advisory 3 (9 PM CST Tue Oct 13): Tropical Storm Trudy strengthened to 45 mph (40 kt), pressure 1004 mb, at 11.2N 97.0W (~440 mi SSE of Acapulco), moving NW at 10 mph. Forecast: hurricane by Wednesday night, major hurricane (130 mph) Fri–Sat. Track forecast is faster and nudged east vs prior: Trudy now brought inland over western Mexico later this weekend, emerging into the southern Gulf of California early next week; 'expected to approach the coast of Mexico as a major hurricane later this week.' NHC key message: 'watches could be required for a portion of these areas on Wednesday' (Oct 14). No coastal watches/warnings in effect yet; track confidence low days 3–5.
